response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the rolling hills and lush forests of the medieval kingdom, but something is off. The once-majestic stone walls now seem dull and grey, the flags bearing the royal crest now fluttering in the wind with a faint, eerie glow.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King ARIN, a stout and imposing figure with a thick beard, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors. But something is different. The walls are adorned with strange, glowing tapestries, and the furniture is covered in a thick, velvety fabric that seems to shift and writhe like a living thing.

ARIN
(to his advisors)
I have had enough of the traditional aesthetic. It is time for a new era, one of innovation and progress.

ADVISOR 1
But, Your Majesty, the people will not understand. They are used to the grandeur and majesty of our kingdom.

ARIN
(scoffing)
The people are blind to the future. They will come to see the beauty in our new vision.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The king's advisors are seen wandering the castle grounds, taking in the strange new sights and sounds. They stumble upon a group of courtiers, who are dressed in the latest fashions from the East, complete with intricate patterns and bright, clashing colors.

ADVISOR 2
What sorcery is this?

COURTIER
It is the latest fashion from the land of the rising sun. We have brought it back to the kingdom, and it is a marvel.

ADVISOR 3
But, good sir, this is not the traditional attire of our kingdom. What will the people think?

COURTIER
They will think it is beautiful, Your Majesty. And it will bring us closer to the future.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. The room is filled with the sound of strange, pulsing music, and the air is thick with the scent of incense.

ARIN
(to his advisors)
I have decided. From this day forward, our kingdom will be known as the land of the vaporwave.

ADVISOR 1
But, Your Majesty, what does this mean?

ARIN
(smiling)
It means that we will be the first to adopt the latest trends from the East. We will be the pioneers of a new era, one of innovation and progress.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans out, showing the castle in all its glory. The walls are still grey, but the flags bearing the royal crest now flutter in the wind with a faint, eerie glow. The people of the kingdom are seen walking through the streets, dressed in the latest fashions from the East.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
